purpose: To restore database write capability when transactions fail due to a read-only transaction state.
when_to_use: Use this procedure when the OrdersDbWritesFailing alert fires with a ReadOnlySqlTransaction error.
prerequisites: Access to execute psql commands against orders-db

steps.instruction: Check if the database is in read-only mode.

steps.command: psql -h orders-db -U shop -c "alter system reset default_transaction_read_only" -c "select pg_reload_conf()"
steps.expect: ALTER SYSTEM and NOTICE or similar confirmation

steps.instruction: Confirm the database is no longer in read-only mode.

rollback.instruction: This change cannot be undone directly without re-applying the read-only state, which is not recommended during an incident.

sop_change: Created a new SOP for fixing read-only database transactions.
rca_title: RCA: OrdersDbWritesFailing due to Read-Only Transaction State
short_description: Database rejects INSERT statements because it entered a read-only transaction state.
problem_statement: The orders-db service threw psycopg.errors.ReadOnlySqlTransaction errors, preventing any database writes.
impact: Database writes were failing for the orders-db service.
immediate_resolution: Reset the default transaction read-only setting and reloaded the database configuration.
root_causes: Database default transaction read-only configuration was set to on.

timeline.event: OrdersDbWritesFailing alert fired on orders-db due to ReadOnlySqlTransaction.
Step 2 executed to allow writes on the database and health returned to ok.
